definition: P0=max(abs(V0)); exact computed activeA=where(abs(V0)==P0); g=sign(V0)*Vzeta; Pprime_right=max(g on A); controllingB=exact g-maximizers in A; S=-Pprime_right/P0
units: S numeric equals peak-reduction percent per damping percentage point, no extra100; force rate=.01*Pprime_right in forceunit per damping pp
modal_contribution: c=-sign(V0)*B*omega^2*z/(P0*unitdivisor); private unitdivisor1000 kN, public1 kip, B includesGamma
top5_rule: stable descending abs(c) at each exact right controller, then remaining signed sum; all modes retained separately
near_meaning: diagnostic only, all saved points within1% and local maxima separately; does not change exact A/B
alternative_local_peaks: save 5 largest local absolute peaks per floor even outside1% gap, no target-informed selection
rank: ascending S per input; exact equal values have equal competition rank
finite_reference_use: only after baseline S/modal freeze, posterior comparison using existing 6/7/8/10 reference small tables; never select modes/thresholds using targets
numerical_scope: computed saved-grid right derivative, not continuous extrema or rigorously enclosed floating states
